risks: Supplier cost unknown: only a Rs 1,400/kg listing price (Puri) found; per-set cost depends on piece weight and making charge - get a written quote before any evaluation
'Pure kansa / bell metal / bronze' and any alloy ratio (e.g. 78:22) are material claims needing a supplier test report (policy require_evidence_for_claims); brass or plated look-alikes are common
Bell metal is brittle and can crack if dropped hard; not glass, but needs rigid padded packing, and transit dents/cracks drive returns
Food-contact item: avoid health/Ayurvedic benefit claims in copy (regulated-claim risk); sell as tableware only
Mass-marketplace (Meesho/Amazon.in) katori set price not found - if generic 'kansa' bowls sell near Rs 300-500 there, the Rs 1,299 price will not hold
Tarnishes; needs care card (tamarind/lemon cleaning, no dishwasher) to limit 'not as pictured' complaints
Retail comparables are D2C brand prices from search snippets, not opened pages; re-check live
GST for bronze tableware (HSN 7418) to be confirmed by the CA; 12% used as a conservative estimate
